verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ יְדִיתוּן לְאָסָ֥ף מִזְמֽוֹר׃ קוֹלִ֣י אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶצְעָ֑קָה קוֹלִ֥י אֶל־ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וְהַאֲזִ֥ין אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- yə·ḏī·ṯūn lə·’ā·sāp̄ miz·mō·wr qō·w·lî ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’eṣ·‘ā·qāh qō·w·lî ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ha·’ă·zîn ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: For the choirmaster According to Jeduthun A Psalm of Asaph I cried out to God I cried aloud . . . to God to hear me
verses.literalPt: Com a minha voz clamarei a Deus; com a minha voz a Deus clamarei, e ele me escutará.

verses.original: בְּי֥וֹם צָרָתִי֮ אֲדֹנָ֪י דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי יָדִ֤י׀ לַ֣יְלָה נִ֭גְּרָה וְלֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm ṣā·rā·ṯî ’ă·ḏō·nāy dā·rā·šə·tî yā·ḏî lay·lāh nig·gə·rāh wə·lō ṯā·p̄ūḡ mê·’ă·nāh hin·nā·ḥêm nap̄·šî
verses.literal: In the day of trouble I sought the Lord through the night my outstretched hands . . . did not grow weary my soul refused to be comforted
verses.literalPt: No dia da minha angústia, busquei ao Senhor; de noite, a minha mão ficou estendida e não afrouxou; a minha alma recusou ser consolada.

verses.original: אֶזְכְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶֽהֱמָיָ֑ה אָשִׂ֓יחָה׀ וְתִתְעַטֵּ֖ף רוּחִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ez·kə·rāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’e·hĕ·mā·yāh ’ā·śî·ḥāh wə·ṯiṯ·‘aṭ·ṭêp̄ rū·ḥî se·lāh
verses.literal: I remembered You O God and I groaned I mused and my spirit grew faint Selah
verses.literalPt: Lembro-me de Deus e fico em desassossego; ponho-me a cismar, e desfalece o meu espírito. (Selá)

verses.original: אָ֭חַזְתָּ שְׁמֻר֣וֹת עֵינָ֑י נִ֝פְעַ֗מְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥaz·tā šə·mu·rō·wṯ ‘ê·nāy nip̄·‘am·tî wə·lō ’ă·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: You have kept my eyes from closing I am too troubled . . . to speak
verses.literalPt: Não me deixaste fechar os olhos; estava perturbado e não podia falar.

verses.original: חִשַּׁ֣בְתִּי יָמִ֣ים מִקֶּ֑דֶם שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת עוֹלָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḥiš·šaḇ·tî yā·mîm miq·qe·ḏem šə·nôt̲ ‘ō·w·lā·mîm
verses.literal: I considered the days of old the years long in the past
verses.literalPt: Pensava nos dias de outrora, nos anos dos tempos passados.

verses.original: אֶֽזְכְּרָ֥ה נְגִינָתִ֗י בַּ֫לָּ֥יְלָה עִם־ לְבָבִ֥י אָשִׂ֑יחָה וַיְחַפֵּ֥שׂ רוּחִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ez·kə·rāh nə·ḡî·nā·ṯî bal·lā·yə·lāh ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇî ’ā·śî·ḥāh way·ḥap·pêś rū·ḥî
verses.literal: At night I remembered my song in my heart I mused and my spirit pondered
verses.literalPt: Lembro-me do meu cântico à noite; consulto com o meu coração, e o meu espírito perscruta.

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַ֥ח׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י וְלֹֽא־ יֹסִ֖יף לִרְצ֣וֹת עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: hal·‘ō·w·lā·mîm yiz·naḥ ’ă·ḏō·nāy wə·lō- yō·sîp̄ lir·ṣō·wṯ ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Will the Lord spurn us forever and never . . . . . . show His favor again
verses.literalPt: Acaso rejeitará o Senhor para sempre? Não tornará ele a ser favorável?

verses.original: הֶאָפֵ֣ס לָנֶ֣צַח חַסְדּ֑וֹ גָּ֥מַר אֹ֝֗מֶר לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: he·’ā·p̄ês lā·ne·ṣaḥ ḥas·dōw gā·mar ’ō·mer lə·ḏōr wā·ḏōr
verses.literal: Is His loving devotion gone forever Has His promise failed for all time . . .
verses.literalPt: Já cessou para sempre a sua benignidade? Acabou-se a sua promessa para todas as gerações?

verses.original: הֲשָׁכַ֣ח חַנּ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל אִם־ קָפַ֥ץ בְּ֝אַ֗ף רַחֲמָ֥יו סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·šā·ḵaḥ ḥan·nō·wṯ ’êl ’im- qā·p̄aṣ bə·’ap̄ ra·ḥă·māw se·lāh
verses.literal: Has God . . . forgotten to be gracious Has His anger shut off His compassion Selah
verses.literalPt: Esqueceu-se Deus de ser compassivo? Encerrou ele na ira as suas ternas misericórdias?

verses.original: וָ֭אֹמַר חַלּ֣וֹתִי הִ֑יא שְׁ֝נ֗וֹת יְמִ֣ין עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ḥal·lō·w·ṯî hî šə·nôt̲ yə·mîn ‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: So I said I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, disse eu: Esta é a minha enfermidade, mas eu me lembrarei dos anos da destra do Altíssimo.

verses.original: אַזְכִּיר מַֽעַלְלֵי־ יָ֑הּ כִּֽי־ אֶזְכְּרָ֖ה מִקֶּ֣דֶם פִּלְאֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ʾaz·kīr ma·‘al·lê- yāh kî- ’ez·kə·rāh miq·qe·ḏem pil·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: I will remember the works of the LORD yes I will remember Your wonders of old
verses.literalPt: Comemorarei os feitos de Jeová, sim, me lembrarei das tuas maravilhas da antiguidade.

verses.original: וְהָגִ֥יתִי בְכָל־ פָּעֳלֶ֑ךָ וּֽבַעֲלִ֖ילוֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·ḡî·ṯî ḇə·ḵāl- pā·‘o·le·ḵā ū·ḇa·‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯe·ḵā ’ā·śî·ḥāh
verses.literal: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds
verses.literalPt: Meditarei também em todas as tuas obras e ponderarei os teus feitos.

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ מִי־ אֵ֥ל גָּ֝ד֗וֹל כֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm baq·qō·ḏeš dar·ke·ḵā mî- ’êl gā·ḏō·wl kê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Your way O God is holy What god is so great as our God
verses.literalPt: O teu caminho é, ó Deus, em santidade. Quem é deus grande como Deus?

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה הָ֭אֵל עֹ֣שֵׂה פֶ֑לֶא הוֹדַ֖עְתָּ בָעַמִּ֣ים עֻזֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh hā·’êl ‘ō·śêh p̄e·le hō·w·ḏa‘·tā ḇā·‘am·mîm ‘uz·ze·ḵā
verses.literal: You are the God who works wonders You display Your strength among the peoples
verses.literalPt: Tu és o Deus que fazes maravilhas. Tens feito notória a tua força entre os povos.

verses.original: גָּאַ֣לְתָּ בִּזְר֣וֹעַ עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּנֵי־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְיוֹסֵ֣ף סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: gā·’al·tā biz·rō·w·a‘ ‘am·me·ḵā bə·nê- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yō·w·sêp̄ se·lāh
verses.literal: With power You redeemed Your people the sons of Jacob and Joseph Selah
verses.literalPt: Com o teu braço, remiste o teu povo, os filhos de Jacó e de José. (Selá)

verses.original: רָ֘א֤וּךָ מַּ֨יִם׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים רָא֣וּךָ מַּ֣יִם יָחִ֑ילוּ אַ֝֗ף יִרְגְּז֥וּ תְהֹמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’ū·ḵā ma·yim ’ĕlō·hîm rā·’ū·ḵā ma·yim yā·ḥî·lū ’ap̄ yir·gə·zū ṯə·hō·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: The waters saw You O God the waters saw You and swirled even the depths were shaken
verses.literalPt: Viram-te as águas, ó Deus; viram-te as águas e temeram. Os abismos também se abalaram.

verses.original: זֹ֤רְמוּ מַ֨יִם׀ עָב֗וֹת ק֭וֹל נָתְנ֣וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים אַף־ חֲ֝צָצֶ֗יךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: zō·rə·mū ma·yim ‘ā·ḇō·wṯ qō·wl nā·ṯə·nū šə·ḥā·qîm ’ap̄- ḥă·ṣā·ṣe·ḵā yiṯ·hal·lā·ḵū
verses.literal: The clouds poured down water the skies resounded with thunder Your arrows flashed back and forth
verses.literalPt: Desfizeram-se em águas as nuvens; os céus fizeram soar a sua voz. Também as suas setas correram duma para outra parte.

verses.original: ק֤וֹל רַעַמְךָ֨׀ בַּגַּלְגַּ֗ל הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקִ֣ים תֵּבֵ֑ל רָגְזָ֖ה וַתִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl ra·‘am·ḵā bag·gal·gal hê·’î·rū ḇə·rā·qîm tê·ḇêl rā·ḡə·zāh wat·tir·‘aš hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind the lightning lit up the world the earth trembled and quaked
verses.literalPt: A voz do teu trovão estava no redemoinho; os relâmpagos alumiaram o mundo; a terra tremeu e estremeceu-se.

verses.original: בַּיָּ֤ם דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ וּשְׁבִילֶיךָ בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝עִקְּבוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נֹדָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yām dar·ke·ḵā ū·šə·ḇī·lɛ·ḵå̄ bə·ma·yim rab·bîm wə·‘iq·qə·ḇō·w·ṯe·ḵā lō nō·ḏā·‘ū
verses.literal: Your path led through the sea Your way through the mighty waters but Your footprints were not to be found
verses.literalPt: O teu caminho foi no mar, as tuas veredas, nas grandes águas, e os teus passos não foram conhecidos.

verses.original: נָחִ֣יתָ כַצֹּ֣אן עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּֽיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḥî·ṯā ḵaṣ·ṣōn ‘am·me·ḵā bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron
verses.literalPt: Conduziste o teu povo, como um rebanho, pela mão de Moisés e de Arão.
